title: Serializer/OpenAPI annotation rules for endpoints
answers: Where should input validation go in a PostHog endpoint?
What OpenAPI annotations do custom actions need?
body:
- Validation lives in serializer `validate_<field>`/`validate`, not viewset methods.
- Prefer `@validated_request` (posthog/api/mixins.py) over manual `is_valid()` + `@extend_schema`.
- Every custom `@action` needs `@extend_schema` or `@validated_request`, otherwise drf-spectacular finds zero parameters. Plain `ViewSet` methods need annotations; `ModelViewSet` with `serializer_class` is auto-discovered. Put the decorator on the actual method (get/post/list/create).
- Errors are typed with `OpenApiResponse(response=ErrorSerializer)`; list endpoints declare pagination.
- Fields need `help_text`; `SerializerMethodField` needs `@extend_schema_field`.
- Source: .agents/skills/improving-drf-endpoints/SKILL.md checklist.
applies: Applies to endpoints that feed the generated OpenAPI/TS clients; the SKILL checklist was read only in part, so check the file for the full list.
